model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the results of a survey question asking respondents to what extent design is integrated into the product development process within their organization. The chart is divided into five colored segments, each representing a different level of integration, with the corresponding numerical values and percentages shown in a legend to the left. The largest segment, colored green, represents the response "Добре е интегриран." (Well integrated), accounting for 25% of the responses (25 individuals). The second largest segment, orange, corresponds to "Много добре е интегриран." (Very well integrated), with 24% (24 individuals). The purple segment, labeled "Не е интегриран такъв подход." (This approach is not integrated), represents 20% (20 individuals). The blue segment, "Изцяло е интегриран." (Fully integrated), accounts for 10% (10 individuals). The smallest segment, red, is "Слабо е интегриран." (Poorly integrated), representing 8% (8 individuals). The percentages sum to 100%, and the chart visually emphasizes the distribution of opinions, with the green and orange slices being the most prominent.
